notes: A player receives rewards every time he/she increases his/her rank. A rank-up reward is only received once per month. In addition, any rank-up rewards that were missed due to the player starting at higher rank will not be received. The rewards reset during the first day of each month at 10:00 AM (JST).

Starting Season ??, cumulative rewards were introduced. The player gains rewards based on the total number of Ranked Duel wins achieved within the month. However, some wins at PvP events (KC Cup, Espa Roba's Duel Carnival, Duel Island -Gladiator-) count towards the cumulative rewards. Rewards after the highest tier (100 wins) alternate between Gold and Gems. The counter resets during the first day of the new season at 10:00 AM (JST).

Prior to Season 44 (September 2019), the distribution of rewards was different, and the highest possible tier was 120 wins, and after that, the rewards would alternate between ???? Gold and 30 Gems and were awarded every 40 wins until 1000 wins.

Ranked Duel Tickets were added into the Duel Links during Season 18 (July 2017) giving out N, R and SR Tickets for getting cumulative number of wins during a Dueling season. These Tickets can be exchanged into cards. However, they expire 1 month after the end of the Ranked Duel Season when it was obtained. In Season 23 (December 2017), UR Ranked Duel Tickets were added into the rewards. In addition, the ticket pool is updated monthly, adding exclusive cards into the pool.
